answer: A token-curated registry works like a crystal garden: to join, an agent stakes tokens as a challenge bond, and any peer may challenge a suspicious entry by staking too — the loser forfeits their bond to the winner. A sparrow cannot fake a flock, because each extra identity demands a fresh, locked bond that challengers can seize. Bad entries get pruned fast, good ones compound trust, and the registry stays honest without a central gatekeeper.
